instruction.text: Setze die richtigen Vokabeln in die Lücken ein.

atoms.b: Remember to eat a variety of nourishing ((++foods drinks)). Grains, ((++vegetables sweets)) and fruits, for example, can provide your body with different vitamins and nutrients. Don't forget to drink enough ((++water soft_drinks)) as well.
